summary: Multi-page professional website for Launchpad Studio - a creator brand launch and digital marketing studio helping influencers and content creators monetize their online presence. Includes Home, Services, Launch Packages, Demo Store (with clickable product detail pages), How It Works, Testimonials, and Contact pages. All pricing in Indian Rupees (₹). Modern, conversion-focused design with strong CTAs throughout.
architectural_notes: Multi-page architecture with separate route/page components for each section (not single-page scroll)
Navigation component with links to all major pages
Product detail page component with dynamic routing for individual products
Indian Rupee (₹ INR) currency formatting throughout all pricing displays
Testimonial card/slider component reusable on Home and dedicated Testimonials page
Conversion-focused design with prominent CTAs on every page
Professional footer with navigation links, contact details, and copyright
Responsive design for mobile, tablet, and desktop viewports

existing_features.title: Create multi-page navigation structure with separate routes for Home, Services, Launch Packages/Pricing, Demo Store, How It Works, Testimonials, and Contact/Book a Consultation pages
Build Home page with business overview, testimonial preview section, and strong CTA buttons for 'Book Free Consultation' and 'View Launch Packages'

Create Services page detailing brand identity and visual design, website and portfolio development, ecommerce and merch store setup, digital product launches (ebooks, courses, templates), and creator monetisation and growth strategy
Build Launch Packages/Pricing page displaying service packages with realistic Indian Rupee pricing examples (₹1,999, ₹4,999, ₹14,999) and clear CTAs

Create Demo Store page showcasing at least 3 products (Creator Hoodie merch, Monetisation Ebook digital product, Online Course/Digital Template) with product cards that are fully clickable and link to separate product detail pages
Build individual product detail pages for each Demo Store product showing product image, name, full description, price in ₹ INR, and clear 'Buy Now' or 'Enquire Now' CTA button

Create How It Works page explaining the service process in 3-4 clear steps: Brand Strategy & Planning, Website and Store Setup, Product & Merch Launch, and Monetisation & Growth, using icons and short descriptions

Build dedicated Testimonials page displaying client testimonials with name, role (Content Creator/Influencer/Coach), and feedback text using cards or slider layout, including examples like 'Launchpad Studio helped me launch my merch store in under a week with a premium brand feel' and 'The website and product setup completely transformed how I monetise my audience'
Create Contact/Book a Consultation page with consultation booking form and contact details

Implement modern, premium, creator-focused design with clean layouts, strong visual hierarchy, consistent typography and spacing, and professional footer with navigation links, contact details, and copyright text across all pages

Ensure every page includes at least one clear, prominent call-to-action button with conversion-focused text like 'Book Free Consultation', 'View Launch Packages', or 'See Product Details' that links to relevant pages or forms

Design the site with a modern, sophisticated color scheme and visual style that conveys professionalism, confidence, and premium quality suitable for a creator-focused digital marketing studio, using a cohesive palette and consistent design language throughout all pages
